snippet.title: Littermates! 8 player Co-op game about raccoons that steal a garbage truck!
snippet.description:
In Littermates you play as raccoons! Grab your mates, steal some litter, and help the denizens of Raccoon-opolis as the newest member of The Duke's crew. Physics Mayhem with up to 8 mates! Drive your stolen Garbage Truck around neighbourhoods, racing to stay ahead of the sunrise as you try to collect everything that isn't nailed down.

In this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-8 players, you need to drive your truck, complete ridiculous missions for the other raccoons, steal everything you can, and race to stay ahead of the sun!

Live your best raccoon life, and make YOUR raccoon with a full character creator. 

Littermates demo is now available! Get it on steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4735880/Littermates/
